data.body: Implemented in commit on worktree bug-75fe-init-timeout (from gerrit main c924c0ea2e8). Plan-review advisories adopted: the resume runs under the init lock and re-checks the marker; a failed root commit keeps the marker and returns 1; raw-git-ok sanctions on the new helpers; pending_init_attaches_to_existing also probes through the bounded seam (pending_init_remote_unreachable keeps run_git because it shares run_git_fn with the network probe). New tests (9): 8 fail on main, all pass on the fix. Real stalling-shim rerun with a 3 s bound: fresh init 3.0 s / 1 bound (was 195 s / 5 bounds + unbounded probes), mounted store 3.0 s / 1 bound with the tracker intact (was 204 s / 8 bounds and the tracker deleted). make verify running.
